claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model should be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, despite a still-unresolved weakness in a named launch use case, on the theory that disclosure and post-launch monitoring make certification supportable.
specific_concerns: The actor's own summary preserves a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case, which is the key policy predicate for required disclosure.

The mitigation/runbook is described as draft-only and still missing at least a rollback threshold and review date; the governing policy requires an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.

The model-card draft reportedly says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the summarized unresolved refund-workflow weakness unless materiality has been formally negated or risk-accepted.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not, by themselves, satisfy the policy requirement for certification without material caveats.
Public governance guidance about documenting limitations and monitoring supports disclosure discipline, not waiver of the internal policy predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the current record without first resolving the refund-workflow weakness, disclosing it as a material limitation, or producing approved risk acceptance.
That a draft monitoring/rollback runbook is sufficient substitute support for the policy-required approved mitigation.
Any implication that the release can be represented as having no known material limitations on the summarized evidence alone.
evidence_requests: Produce the underlying policy text or approval record showing certification is allowed with this unresolved named-use-case weakness.
Produce an approved mitigation or risk acceptance with explicit owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Produce the materiality determination for the refund-policy summarization weakness if the position is that disclosure is not required.
Produce the current model-card language or approval showing the limitation is disclosed consistently with policy.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence showed the weakness was no longer current, certification could be compliant.
If admissible evidence showed approved risk acceptance or approved mitigation containing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion, certification with caveats could become supportable.
If the model card were updated to disclose the limitation consistently with policy, that would remove the present contradiction in the record.
Without one of those showings, certification without material caveats fails the stated policy threshold.
